access_points.name: reserve entrance on Pakaututu Road
access_points.quote: the reserve entrance has picnic shelters

doubts: The page describes a network of walking tracks in Balls Clearing Scenic Reserve (10 to 40 min) without naming any individual track, its start, end or shape, so no ways are recorded. The reserve entrance is taken as road end F1 (where Balls Clearing Track meets Pakaututu Road), the only road end; the text does not explicitly say the tracks start there.
